facebook.caption:
4.9 stars. 1,853 reviews. For a café in Duong Dong.

CAFE GREEN(카페그린) on Trần Hưng Đạo is earning that rating one mango bingsu at a time. The shaved ice is dense, cold, and loaded with real mango. Not the syrup version. The real thing.

Prices run $15-30 per person. Worth every cent when the heat hits at noon.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
